Class Smarts2MQLVisitor

java.lang.Object
org.openscience.cdk.smiles.smarts.parser.Smarts2MQLVisitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
SMARTSParserVisitor
@Deprecated public class Smarts2MQLVisitor extends Object implements SMARTSParserVisitor
Deprecated.
An AST tree visitor. It is a prototype that translate Smarts to MQL. It is far from fully functioning.

Dazhi Jiao
